notablePrerequisites: There are at least four land cards in your graveyard.
description:
Cast Warhost's Frenzy with kicker by paying {2}{B}{R}.
Activate Lluwen by paying {2}{B/G}{B/G}{B/G}, tapping it and discarding Dakmor Salvage, creating a 1/1 Wurm creature token for each land card in your graveyard.
Activate Phyrexian Altar five times by sacrificing five Wurms, adding {2}{B/G}{B/G}{B/G}.
When the Wurms die, Warhost's Frenzy and Lluwen trigger five times each.
Resolve all Lluwen triggers, untapping it.
Resolve the first Warhost's Frenzy trigger, instead choosing to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve all remaining Warhost's Frenzy triggers, drawing that many cards.
Repeat from step 2.
